question: Which state won the 14th Hockey India Senior Men National Championship, 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Odisha**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The state of Odisha won the 14th Hockey India Senior Men National Championship held in 2024.
 
• Odisha secured the title by defeating Maharashtra in the final match.
 
• The championship saw participation from numerous state teams, showcasing high-level competition.
 
• This victory highlights the growing prominence of Odisha in Indian hockey, furthering their reputation as a strong contender in national tournaments.
 
• The tournament was organized by Hockey India, the governing body for field hockey in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Hockey India:**

 
 
• Hockey India is the governing body for field hockey in India, responsible for the promotion and development of the sport at all levels.
 
• It was established in 2009 and is recognized by the Indian Olympic Association and the International Hockey Federation (FIH).
 
• Hockey India organizes various national championships and league competitions, contributing to the growth of the sport in the country.
 
 
 
• **Field Hockey in India:**
 
 
• Field hockey is one of the most popular sports in India, with a rich history of success in international competitions.
 
• India has won multiple Olympic gold medals in hockey, with the first victory coming in 1928.
 
• The sport is governed by Hockey India, which oversees the national teams and domestic competitions.
 
 
 
• **Odisha's Contribution to Indian Hockey:**
 
 
• Odisha has emerged as a significant contributor to Indian hockey, hosting major tournaments and providing infrastructure support.
 
• The state government has invested in the development of hockey facilities, including the Kalinga Stadium in Bhubaneswar.
 
• Several prominent Indian hockey players have emerged from Odisha, contributing to the national team's success.
 
 
 
• **National Championships:**
 
 
• The Hockey India Senior Men National Championship is an annual tournament that brings together state teams from across the country.
 
• The championship serves as a platform for identifying and nurturing talent for the national team.
 
• It provides an opportunity for players to showcase their skills and compete at a high level.
